name: Agent Bobby Free
summary: Vendor-hosted free MCP for stock briefs, two-stock compares and a market pulse. Pro is a separate Apple subscription. Not financial advice.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (submitted for @pete-lgtm / Agent Bobby). The hosted service is operated by Loxidev LLC and is proprietary. JSON-RPC initialize at https://bobby.markets/mcp/free returned 200 on 2026-11-14 without a key (serverInfo name “Agent Bobby Free”, version 1.2.0). Unauthenticated tools/list returned 4 tools: start_bobby_setup, get_free_stock_brief, compare_two_stocks_free, and get_free_market_pulse. A GET of /mcp/free returned 405; use Streamable HTTP / JSON-RPC. https://bobby.markets/mcp (without /free) returned 401 with WWW-Authenticate Bearer. Homepage, https://bobby.markets/llms.txt, https://bobby.markets/agents.md and https://bobby.markets/openapi.json were HTTP 200. https://bobby.markets/pricing returned 404 on 2026-11-14 and is not used as a URL or source; prices below are from the Terms of Use (last updated 2026-09-30). Terms: not financial advice; optional SnapTrade read-only brokerage linking is described and was not used. Bobby Pro is an auto-renewing Apple ID subscription listed at $17.99/month or $149.99/year, with a 7-day trial for new subscribers; cancel at least 24 hours before renewal. Privacy policy (last updated 2026-10-16): marketing page-view and App Store click counts go to the loxi.dev studio dashboard; no cookies or persistent visitor IDs and no IP storage are described; DNT/GPC are excluded; aggregate usage counts are without user or portfolio identifiers. llms.txt: no bulk redistribution grant; check timestamps; not an execution feed. Agent Room is a separate registration flow and was not signed up for. start_bobby_setup is documented as not creating accounts and was not called. No signup, wallet, or payment was used. license proprietary; pricing freemium (free MCP plus paid Pro).

agent_access.notes: Streamable HTTP MCP at /mcp/free. initialize and tools/list succeeded without a key on 2026-11-14 (4 tools). GET /mcp/free returned 405; /mcp without /free returned 401 Bearer. Pro is a separate Apple subscription. start_bobby_setup and paid/account flows were not called.
